explication: Darwin Skill is an agent skill for iteratively improving other SKILL.md files. Its principal workflow evaluates a baseline, edits one dimension, independently validates the change, keeps improvements or reverts regressions, and pauses for human review. README documentation supplies the workflow and capabilities; the only sampled source is a peripheral screenshot script, so stage-level implementation details are attributed to SKILL.md without claiming its contents were inspected.
